acceptance_criteria.given: A project with quiet hours 22:00-08:00 and the clock at 02:00
acceptance_criteria.then: No notification is delivered and the notice is recorded as deferred.
acceptance_criteria.when: An agent raises a non-blocking notification
An agent raises a blocking question

acceptance_criteria.then: A digest is delivered containing all three.

acceptance_criteria.given: Six notices deferred from two agents
acceptance_criteria.then: It contains two groups, one per agent, not six entries in arrival order.

acceptance_criteria.given: A new project with no quiet window configured
acceptance_criteria.then: The window reads 22:00-08:00 in the project's declared timezone.

acceptance_criteria.given: A project with quiet hours disabled
acceptance_criteria.then: It is delivered immediately, and nothing is deferred.
acceptance_criteria.when: An agent raises a non-blocking notification at 02:00

acceptance_criteria.given: A digest configured to deliver in-conversation
acceptance_criteria.then: The digest appears as one conversation entry and no separate surface opens.

lifecycle: Merged from quiet-hours-for-agent-notifications on first adoption of the capability corpus.

requirements.rationale: Losing a question silently is the failure this feature exists to prevent.
requirements.statement: A notification raised inside the quiet window is deferred, not dropped.

requirements.rationale: A run that cannot continue without an answer is already costing time.
requirements.statement: A blocking question overrides the quiet window and notifies immediately.
Every deferred notification appears in the next digest after the window closes.

requirements.rationale: Six notices from one agent read as one situation, not six.
requirements.statement: The digest groups deferred notifications by agent rather than by arrival time.
The quiet window defaults to 22:00-08:00 in the project's declared timezone.
A project may disable quiet hours entirely.
The digest may be delivered as a conversation entry rather than a separate surface.

in_scope: A morning digest of everything deferred
non_goals: Timezone inference from the host clock
Any change to how questions are routed

summary: Agents defer non-urgent notifications during a configured quiet window and deliver them afterwards as a grouped digest. Blocking questions are exempt and always notify immediately.
title: Quiet hours
